counterhypotheses_preserved: The apparent binding gap may still partly be a template-position/codebook-order shortcut rather than missing general routing; crossed display-order generator v2 directly pressures this.
A binder-focused fine-tune may improve episode routing while degrading retained general/protocol competence; retention floors remain required.
Static hidden-state transport can remain noncausal for behavior; behavioral binding success and same-model intervention evidence must remain separate gates.
A source-level gate can itself encode a flawed holdout definition; holdout isolation must cover calibration/validation exposure, not merely gradient-training exposure.
